name: Dunkin' Classic Glazed Yeast Ring Donut (Remission Treat)
whyItWorks: A light, airy yeast-risen ring with a simple sugar glaze. Has no seeds, nuts, spices, or heavy cream fillings. Safe as an occasional treat during solid remission; avoid during active flares due to frying oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Select the classic Glazed Yeast Donut. Avoid filled, jelly, chocolate, or sprinkle-topped varieties.
